lines.1: This morning too, I greeted Sato in front of the school gate.
lines.4: Her face lit up in a bright smile.
lines.5: All right. Let's do our best today too.
lines.7: 「Iron-senpai, Sato... I don't understand why either of them pays attention to Tsushima.」
lines.10: The people in our class were making as much noise as they pleased.
lines.11: Some were even playing mahjong with cards.
lines.12: Inori was dozing off and completely nonfunctional.
lines.13: 「Everyone, quiet down! You're bothering the other classes! Come on, listen to me!」
